title: 384-well Plate One-to-One Transfer
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol moves up to 384 samples from 1 source plate to 1 destination plate using a P50-multichannel GEN1 pipette. The source plate is a Greiner Bio-One 384-well plate, and the destination plate can be either a Corning 384-well plate or a Bio-Rad 384-well plate. Samples are transferred across row A (A1, C1, E1, G1, I1, K1, M1, O1; A2, C2, E2, G2, I2, K2, M2, O2; etc.), then across row B (B1, D1, F1, H1, J1, L1, N1, P1; B2, D2, F2, H2, J2, L2, N2, P2; etc.). --- To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our [online store](https://shop.opentrons.com/) or contact our sales team at [info@opentrons.com](mailto:info@opentrons.com) * [Opentrons OT-2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/ot-2) * [Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 4.0.0 or later)](https://opentrons.com/ot-app/) * [Opentrons P50 Multi-Channel Pipette GEN1](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes) * [Opentrons 96 Tiprack 300ul](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips) * [Greiner Bio-One 384 Well Plate 100 µL #781720](https://www.gbo.com/en_US.html) * [Corning 384 Well Plate 20 µL #4511](https://ecatalog.corning.com/life-sciences/b2c/EUOther/en/Microplates/Assay-Microplates/384-Well-Microplates/Corning®-384-well-Solid-Black-and-White-Polystyrene-Microplates/p/4511) * [Bio-Rad 384 Well Plate 50 µL #HSR4801](https://www.bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsr4801-hard-shell-384-well-pcr-plates-clear-clear-barcoded?ID=HSR4801) For more detailed information on compatible labware, please visit our [Labware Library](https://labware.opentrons.com/).
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Configure transfer layout
steps.instruction: Plan a one‑to‑one transfer of up to 384 samples using a P50‑multichannel GEN1 pipette. Use a Greiner Bio‑One 384‑well source plate and a destination plate that is either a Corning 384‑well plate or a Bio‑Rad 384‑well plate. Transfer wells across row A (A1, C1, E1, G1, I1, K1, M1, O1; A2, C2, …) then across row B (B1, D1, F1, H1, J1, L1, N1, P1; B2, D2, …) as illustrated.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (Version 4.0.0 or later), input all required protocol parameters for the transfer.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Click the download button to save the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the OT‑2 deck according to the provided deck map: place a 96‑tip rack (300 µL tips), the Greiner Bio‑One 384‑well source plate, the chosen 384‑well destination plate (Corning or Bio‑Rad), and mount the P50‑multichannel GEN1 pipette in the appropriate mount.

steps.title: Calibrate labware
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 Run App, calibrate the tip rack, source plate, destination plate, and the P50‑multichannel GEN1 pipette (refer to the support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 Run App to start the one‑to‑one transfer.
